claim_rule: All claims must hold across all strata or be labeled stratum-dependent.
forbidden: choosing k, q, or delta after Stage 2 results

stage_1.name: screening_only
stage_1.restriction: No final claim may be made from Stage 1.

stage_2.held_out_requirement: Use disjoint held-out traces or held-out tasks.
stage_2.name: held_out_validation
stage_2.parameter_lock: k, q, delta, projections, metrics, and strata rules must be fixed before Stage 2.

strata.S_rand: overlapping uniform random audit sample with a fixed seed

strata_semantics.partition_rule: Only S_low, S_mid, and S_high are expected to sum to the Stage 2 trace count.
